With the largest medical supply showroom in Arizona, if you need it, there’s a good chance we have it. Whether you’re recovering from surgery, managing a chronic condition, or looking for equipment that makes daily life safer and more comfortable at home, our Phoenix store has what you need. That includes power lift chairs, home hospital beds, manual and power wheelchairs, mobility scooters, walkers and rollators, CPAP and BiPAP machines, portable and home oxygen concentrators, knee scooters, patient lifts, bath and shower safety equipment, compression garments, orthopedic bracing, and aids to daily living.

Soon, they fell in love and began the long gratifying journey of starting their own business. CWCF specializes in all custom handmade furnishings, decor, garden gates, handrails, as well as many other custom pieces. All items are made from 100% American grade steel and recycled lumber. As well as, powder coated with the most durable indoor/outdoor rated powder coat in the industry. All items are custom-made to order. CWCF takes absolute pride in creating one of a kind pieces for your home.
